held.title: An identity entry set to null is turned into `{}`, which assigns the identity instead of removing it.
held.body: `clean_null_values(properties) or {}` maps a `None` value to `{}`. In an ARM identity PATCH, `"<id>": null` is the usual way to remove a user-assigned identity, while `"<id>": {}` assigns it. Suppose a manifest writes `userAssignedIdentities: {"<id>": null}` (or `<id>:` with no value in YAML) to detach an identity. Before this change the entry was dropped, so nothing happened. Now `update --yaml` sends `{}`, which attaches or keeps the identity: the opposite of what the user asked for. I could not check whether the Container Apps PATCH honours null-removal here. Fix: keep explicit nulls, e.g. `{i: (None if p is None else (clean_null_values(p) or {})) for i, p in value.items()}`, or at least don't turn `None` into an assignment.
